# C-EQ 3.4.1 — No more distortion on the phone speaker

- **Firmer limiter** on every output: it now acts from −2 dBFS at 30:1 with a 0.5 ms attack (before: −1 dBFS, 10:1, 1 ms), so peaks no longer clip before it reacts. / **Limitador más firme**: los picos ya no se recortan antes de que actúe.
- **Phone-speaker protection** (on by default, only on the phone speaker): bass below 125 Hz that the speaker can't play isn't boosted, extra volume goes up to +2 dB and headroom is kept. You can turn it off in Options. / **Protección del altavoz del teléfono** (activa por defecto): no sube los graves que el altavoz no puede dar y limita el volumen extra.
